definition: A placed candidate the drawability check finds holding every fact of its house type it could judge, with no room past its own proportion band. A fact nobody could judge, such as an unstated fire, is named beside it and never counted as held.
more: It is the second of the two counts a composed set is read by, and it is a subset of the candidates not refused. Where a fact is unjudged on every candidate, the count is drawable where judged and not drawable outright.
basis: Our wording of the phase's acceptance instrument as the composer reads it. build/compose.py, card_drawability: every fact the instrument could not judge is "named, because an unjudged fact is never called held. `None` for a record with no placement"; set_drawability: how many of the not-refused are "DRAWABLE WHERE JUDGED (`drawability.assess`", which "finds every judged fact held and no room past its band), with each fact nobody could judge" counted by name.
